dial.summary: The 2s10s yield curve steepened to +0.47% on a confirmed 30-day basis (upgraded to supportive for the first time this cycle), DXY edged down to 99.72 (neutral band), and stablecoin dominance compressed to ~13.1%—five of eight indicators now supportive with only real yields (2.37%) remaining a headwind; BTC.D firm at ~55.8–56%, near-zero funding rates, and OI rising to $47.6B sustain the BTC Accumulation thesis with July NFP (Aug 7) and CPI (Aug 12) as the next regime-change catalysts.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: 4-bank aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) June 2026 confirmed at $102.7T (MacroMicro); July 2026 aggregate not yet published; US M2 (monthly, SA) rose to $23.16T in June 2026—+5.6% YoY, +$1.23T, 28th consecutive monthly increase and a record high, per H.6 released July 28; 4-week trend up (expansion streak intact, YoY growth rate stable at ~5-6%); status supportive (4-week uptrend confirmed; YoY contracting headwind condition not met).

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: July 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI released August 3 at 10:00 AM ET but exact figure was inaccessible from indexed sources at run time (all direct fetches returned 403); TipRanks headline indicates 'rises but misses estimates' vs. the 54.0 consensus, implying a print above 53.3 but below 54.0; S&P Global US Manufacturing PMI (separate index) for July final: 53.8 (vs 53.9 June, missed 54.3 forecast); value held at June 2026 53.3% pending confirmed July read; trend and status carried forward (above 50 but falling from May's 54.0%; status neutral—supportive requires above 50 AND rising).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 99.7210 on August 3, 2026 (Trading Economics)—down -0.19% from August 2, -1.13% over the past month; 30-day trend: ~101.34 (July 1) → 99.72 (August 3) = -1.62%, well above the 0.5% flat threshold, trend down; status NEUTRAL per ICE DXY spot threshold (below 100, above 97.5); sustained break below 97.5 required to upgrade to supportive; continued USD softness reflects market pricing for September FOMC cut ahead of July NFP (August 7) and CPI (August 12).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: DFII10 (10-year TIPS real yield) at 2.37% as of July 31, 2026—peaked at 2.41% on July 29 before easing on soft Q2 GDP (1.5% vs 2.1% est) and core PCE (0.1% MoM vs 0.2% est); July 23 TIPS auction cleared at 2.438%, highest since October 2008; August 3 close not yet confirmed; 4-week trend up: ~2.18% (June 30) → 2.37% (July 31) = +19bps, above the 5bps flat threshold; status headwind (above 2% and rising on 4-week basis; September FOMC cut and August 12 CPI are primary real-yield compression catalysts).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: July 31, 2026: DGS10 4.75%, DGS2 4.28%, spread = +0.47% (Advisor Perspectives / ETF Trends confirmed); 4-week comparison: July 2 spread = 4.49% - 4.14% = +0.35%; 4-week steepening = +12bps, well above the 5bps flat threshold—trend upgraded to 'up'; status upgraded to supportive (positive AND steepening confirmed on 30-day basis for the first time this cycle); long-end yields rose faster than short-end (+26bps vs +14bps), consistent with improving growth expectations and easing inversion risk; headwind threshold (< -50bps) not applicable.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,735,609M ($6.747T) for week ending July 22, 2026 (Convex Trade, confirmed); July 30 H.4.1 release (July 31) indicates ~$6.74T; next H.4.1 release August 6, 2026; 4-week trend flat: estimated ~$6.72T (early July) → $6.747T (July 22) = +$0.027T (+0.40%), within the <0.5% flat threshold; status supportive (flat to marginally growing; QT effectively paused; no aggressive runoff with rising overnight rates).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: Live funding rate inaccessible—CoinGlass, The Block, Bybit, Glassnode all returned HTTP 403; value carried forward at +0.004%/8h; contextual signals: BTC perpetual OI rose to ~$47.6B (from ~$44B a month prior), longs dominate (paying shorts), consistent with modestly positive but not overheated funding; June 8 anchor was ~+0.005%/8h; funding has remained positive since late June 2026; 30-day trend down (from ~+0.006%/8h in late June); status supportive (well below the 0.04%/8h overheating threshold).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$286.9B as of August 2, 2026 (StableCoin.com: USDT $183.3B, USDC $72.0B, combined 89%); total crypto market cap ~$2.2T (range $2.15T–$2.26T across sources, BTC.D ~55.8%); dominance: $286.9B / $2.2T ≈ 13.1%; 30-day trend down: June 30 stablecoin MC $305.1B / TOTAL $2.1T = 14.5% → August 3 ~13.1%, a compression of ~1.4pp as capital rotated into risk assets; status supportive (falling on 30-day basis; headwind threshold requires rising dominance WHILE TOTAL is also rising—not met since TOTAL rose while dominance fell).

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (June 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey for June 2026 at 10:00 AM ET—key labor demand gauge the day after July ISM Manufacturing; macro context: DXY at 99.72 (neutral), real yields at 2.37% (headwind), 2s10s steepening to +0.47% (supportive); a reading below 7.5M openings would reinforce the soft-landing thesis and strengthen the September rate cut case, adding downward pressure on real yields.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (July 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM Services PMI for July 2026 at 10:00 AM ET—companion to the August 3 Manufacturing print; prior June 2026 reading: 54.0% (24th consecutive expansion month); a reading above 54 with price moderation would support DXY sustaining its sub-100 break and add to the case for real yield compression from 2.37%; a miss below 52 combined with a weak August 7 NFP would accelerate September FOMC cut pricing.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended August 1, 2026)
upcoming.note: Weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET—labor market pulse one day ahead of July NFP (August 7); prior week ended July 26 came in at 226k; DXY at 99.72 (neutral), 2s10s at +0.47% (steepening); a print above 250k would add to September rate cut pricing and could compress real yields from current 2.37%.

upcoming.title: Employment Situation / NFP (July 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS Employment Situation for July 2026 at 8:30 AM ET—nonfarm payrolls, unemployment rate, and average hourly earnings; primary labor market read ahead of the September FOMC (Sep 15-16); macro backdrop: DXY at 99.72 (neutral, -1.62% over 4 weeks), 2s10s steepening to +0.47% (supportive), real yields at 2.37% (headwind), global M2 expanding +5.6% YoY; a weak NFP opens the September cut discussion and could compress real yields and push DXY toward the 97.5 supportive threshold; a strong print complicates September cut pricing.
